notes:
User is getting more into yoga and follows Adriene on YouTube but wants more variety (S1.U1). They have used a Fitbit Charge 3 for 9 months to track daily steps and health (S2.U2; superseded: 6 months, S1.U2). They struggle to reach their step goal on “lazy Sundays” and want motivation tips (S1.U2). They replaced their useful yoga mat because knee issues led them to prioritize cushioning, support, quality, and an affordable eco-friendly option; they chose the thicker Hugger Mugger ParaMat and also considered the Manduka eKO SuperLite (S1.U3–S1.U6). They may buy a yoga strap for stretching and pose modification (S1.U6).

User has been experiencing sleep issues but is establishing a consistent bedtime routine and a sleep-conducive environment (S2.U1–S2.U2). They identified pre-bed TV as stimulating and plan to replace it with reading (S2.U2–S2.U3). They use a portable massage roller for workout recovery, stress relief, and muscle tension, and plan to use it before reading, especially on tense neck and shoulders from screen use (S2.U3–S2.U4).

They love non-fiction, especially health and wellness topics such as nutrition, fitness, and mindfulness. Dan Harris’s “10% Happier” particular
